# superset_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group of users by its name, on Superset 6, for example to reference its id in `superset_user.groups`. Group names are unique; the lookup fails when no group has exactly that name. The group endpoints belong to the Flask-AppBuilder security API, which Superset only enables with `FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_group" "analysts" {
  name = "analysts"
}

resource "superset_user" "analyst" {
  username   = "analyst"
  first_name = "Ana"
  last_name  = "Lyst"
  email      = "analyst@example.com"
  password   = "AnalystSamplePass123!"
  roles      = [4]
  groups     = [data.superset_group.analysts.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the group.
- `label` (String) Label of the group, shown in the UI.
- `roles` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the roles the group grants to its members.
- `users` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the members of the group.
